title: Möbius functions for pseudo-Levi subgroups in finite general linear and symplectic groups
summary: In this paper, we compute the Möbius function on the poset of pseudo-Levi subgroups containing a fixed maximal torus of two families of finite groups, $GL_n(q)$ and $Sp_{2n}(q)$, for some natural number $n$ and a prime power $q$, where $q>2n+1$. For the general linear group, we consider arbitrary tori, but for symplectic groups, we restrict to tori corresponding to the bipartitions of $n$ into odd integers.
